units.source_text: 千重子站起来向店铺那边走去，然后下到土间来。

en.t: Chieko stood up and walked toward the shop, then stepped down into the earthen-floored passage.

units.source_text: 这个土间是狭长形状，直通内宅。

en.t: This earthen-floored passage was long and narrow, leading straight into the living quarters.

units.source_text: 在店铺对面的墙边上，有一排黑色炉灶，厨房就在那儿。

en.t: Along the wall opposite the shop stood a row of black cooking stoves, and the kitchen was right there.
